subject.title: fix(gateway): keep configured local auth authoritative

question: Should implicit configured-local Gateway clients switch from the documented environment-first credential default to configuration-first so they always follow the server’s active `gateway.auth.*` credential?
rationale: The patch fixes a real authentication split, but it also changes a documented public precedence contract for existing installations; policy direction determines whether that upgrade change is acceptable or needs an explicit compatibility surface.

options.title: Adopt configured-local authority
options.body: Merge the config-first local policy so implicit clients match the Gateway server, while retaining environment fallback only when no local credential is configured.

options.title: Preserve environment-first compatibility
options.body: Keep the current default and pursue a separate explicit mode or migration path if maintainers still want a strict configured-local policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt configured-local authority
recommendation.body: Merge the config-first local policy so implicit clients match the Gateway server, while retaining environment fallback only when no local credential is configured.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this contributor to the current Gateway-auth investigation and implementation, though broader ownership history could not be read from the checkout.
